frame_row: Integrate CPUs, coherence control, memory/MMIO routing, maintenance, shared LLC, PMU and software diagnostics.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile_array
(m_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile_array)
blocks.function: Replicate active CPU tiles and connect their ownership, query, lock and tagged-probe channels to one shared coherence tile array.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_route
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_route)
blocks.function: Route one tile's AXI transactions to cached memory, normal-uncached bypass, device MMIO or a local error responder.

label: u_vlsit_axi_llc
(m_vlsit_axi_llc)
blocks.function: Wrap the licensed native LLC with VLSIT AXI/service/maintenance and fault-event ports.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_axi_mem_mux
(m_vlsit_riscv_axi_mem_mux)
blocks.function: Arbitrate per-hart memory traffic while preserving source identity and response routing.
